reply_text: I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I noted that the signed order form for Tansley Parcel is due on 25 August. I also pointed out that 25 August had already passed when she wrote (14 October). So I asked whether she meant 25 August next year or whether the order form is already overdue. Nothing else was needed, so I took no other action.
